name: io.glitchr.store
description: A window of the Unity editor that browses the package sources you add - a Forge, a static hub on GitHub Pages, any UPM registry, Git packages, a GitHub organisation's repositories matching a pattern, public or private - and installs, updates and removes their packages in the open project in one click. Open source and agnostic: no source is built in. A hub that sells is bought from in the browser; the key it brings is kept in the user's .upmconfig.toml.
